blocks.text: Networking devices network mein computers aur doosre devices jorne ke liye use hote hain. Yeh data ke bahao ko control karte hain, aur har device ka baat-cheet mein khaas kirdar hai.

blocks.caption: Networking devices aur un ke kaam
rows: Device ko network se jorta hai, wired ya wireless. Har NIC ka munfarid pata hota hai jise MAC address kehte hain. Yeh device ka data bhejta aur wusool karta hai; NIC ke baghair device network par baat nahi kar sakta. Zyada tar jadeed devices mein NIC andar bana hota hai.
Network ke andar devices jorta aur data sirf sahi device ko bhejta hai, jis se network ki raftar aur karkardagi behtar hoti hai. Jadeed networks mein switch aam hain.

Mukhtalif networks ko jorta aur IP addresses ki madad se data packets ko sahi manzil ki taraf bhejta hai. Router local networks ko Internet se jorte aur security aur control behtar karte hain; ghar aur daftar ke networks inhein aam use karte hain.

Local network ko Internet Service Provider (ISP) se jorta hai. Yeh digital data ko line ke qabil signals mein aur aane wale signals ko wapas digital shakal mein badalta hai. Modem cable, DSL ya fibre connections ke saath use hote aur aksar router ke saath kaam karte hain.
Wi-Fi faraham karta hai taake wireless devices network se jur sakein. Yeh wireless phailao barhata aur bari imaraton aur campuses mein signal ki taqat aur istehkam behtar karta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen se daen zanjeer: neeche NIC card wala computer (device ko network se jorta; munfarid MAC address), switch (data sahi device ko), router (mukhtalif networks jorta; IP se packets bhejta), modem (digital data ko line signals mein aur wapas) aur ISP aur Internet ka badal. Router ke neeche wireless access point laptop aur phone ko Wi-Fi deta.
blocks.caption: Networking devices aur un ke kaam (Figs 1.6 aur 1.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Computer ka data us ke NIC se switch, phir router tak jata hai, jo doosre networks ka traffic modem ke zariye ISP ko bhejta hai. Access point wireless devices ko usi network mein shamil hone deta hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Ustad signal badalne ki misal se modem samjhate hain, aur talaba us ka khulasa karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Switch aur router mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Switch aik network ke andar devices jorta aur data sahi device ko bhejta hai; router mukhtalif networks (maslan ghar ka network aur Internet) jorta aur IP addresses se un ke darmiyan packets bhejta hai.
Network interface card (NIC) ka munfarid pata, jo device ke network hardware ki pehchan karata hai.

items: NIC: device ko network se jorta; MAC address.
Switch: network ke andar devices. Router: networks ke darmiyan, IP se.
Modem: digital data line signals mein aur wapas, ISP tak.
Access point: wireless devices ke liye Wi-Fi.
